Posters from Fraternity Movement at the Central University of Kerala on resistance, political prisoners and the people whose struggles we keep in view.

About

Fraternity Movement at the Central University of Kerala works on campus for equality, dignity and social justice. This page collects our posters in one place. Tap any poster to view it full size. Some posters describe allegations and court cases; they are presented as stated on the posters.
